map.四个等级具体怎么判？: How exactly are the four grades judged?
map.四项强度与理化指标全合格且 ΔE≤1.0 判优等品；全合格且 ΔE≤2.0 判一: All four strength and physical-chemical items compliant with ΔE≤1.0 is judged premium; all compliant with ΔE≤2.0 is first-class; at least 3 compliant items with ΔE≤4.0 is judged conforming; otherwise non-conforming. Visible colour difference ΔE matters greatly for high grades, so control ΔE first when appearance requirements are strict.
map.不同石材的限值为什么差别这么大？: Why do stone limits differ so much?
map.因为岩性不同。花岗石要求最高（压缩 100 MPa、吸水 ≤0.60%），大理石: Because the lithology differs. Granite is the most demanding (compressive 100 MPa, water absorption ≤0.60%), marble 50 MPa / ≤0.50%, limestone 60 MPa / ≤3.00%, sandstone 70 MPa / ≤3.00%. After selecting the stone type the tool automatically applies the matching limits.
